utterances.speaker: JUDGE MAY
utterances.text: Could I ask you both if there are any matters you want to raise in relation to the detention or conditions of the accused which we have to review now?

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MAY
utterances.text: Thank you. Very well. As I said, we will consider these motions and give our decisions in writing. We will fix another date for the next hearing which will be, I anticipate, towards the beginning of September. There will be meetings with the senior legal officer.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE MAY
utterances.text: I am reminded that in fact the Status Conference has been timetabled for the 5th of September, so this matter is adjourned until the 5th of September. There will, as I say, be meetings with the senior legal officer and the parties. If there are any other matters which require the Court's attention, then we will order a further hearing.
